title: SiteConfig part 1: JSON schema of the shared-tier settings and the projection.json converter (Python)
description:
Outcome: Write the v1 SiteConfig JSON schema (the allowed and refused settings listed in the parent task) and one converter from a site's projection.json; prove with TI's and MoM's projection.json copied as fixtures that conversion validates and renders the same pages through the existing projector. TypeScript twin is part 2. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) site-config-schema, branch feature/<this issue id>-site-config-schema from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-site-config-schema, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/site_config/ (schema.json, convert.py, tests), fixtures copied from the TI and MoM repositories (read-only).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/site-config-schema.feature):
Scenario: TI's settings convert and render the same
    Given TI's projection.json
    When it is converted to a SiteConfig and back
    Then validation passes and the rendered home page is unchanged

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/site_config; poetry run behave features_backend/site-config-schema.feature.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
